purpose: Daily and on-demand check of the owner's Bitaxe lottery miner: block hit, new best difficulty, offline.
owner_approval: scheduling a daily task (the owner sets it up)
evaluation: check prints the report, exits 0/2/3, and only GETs the miner; wallet, SSID and MAC never appear.

provenance.license: unspecified (the repo owner picks one before publishing)

portability: Python stdlib only; same command on the box.
